At Charming Pet Rescue, we focus on rescuing family-friendly dogs and cats—pets that are good with people and other animals. Many of our dogs play together in outdoor yards, where visitors can meet them in a relaxed, social environment.
 
Founded in 2015, we’ve grown into a lifesaving team of staff, fosters, and volunteers who help rehome over 1,200 animals every year. About a third of our pets stay at the rescue, while the rest are in loving foster homes. Our facility is equipped with heating, A/C, and high-powered fans to keep animals comfortable during their stay.
 
Thanks to our dedicated team and community support, we’re giving more pets a second chance—and helping families find their perfect match.

We’re located in Boerne, TX and adopt out locally in Bexar county and the surrounding area. Check us out: charmingpetrescue.org
